turns.agent:
# Rooftop Jazz — ready-to-build pack

**No AI generation credits needed.** Build this in Canva, Figma or another editor, then reuse the same artwork across all three formats.

## Shared design

- **Background:** warm cream `#F4EBDD`
- **Text and artwork:** deep burgundy `#681F32`
- **Headline font:** Bodoni Moda Bold or Libre Bodoni Bold
- **Details font:** Montserrat Medium
- **Artwork:** a simple burgundy saxophone silhouette with a thin rooftop skyline beneath it.
- **Finish:** thin Art Deco border and optional subtle paper texture.

Use this exact copy throughout:

> **ROOFTOP**  
> **JAZZ**  
>   
> **24 October 2027**  
> **7 PM**  
> **Atlas Roof**  
>   
> **Free entry**

## 1. Poster — 4:5

**Canvas:** 1080 × 1350px  
**Safe margins:** 80px

| Element | Placement and styling |
|---|---|
| Border | 2px burgundy line, inset 45px |
| Title | Centered in upper quarter; two lines, approximately 140px |
| Saxophone | Centered in middle; approximately 330px tall |
| Rooftop skyline | Thin line beneath saxophone |
| Date | Centered below artwork; 48px |
| Time and venue | Separate centered lines; 42px |
| Free entry | Bottom center; 32px inside a thin burgundy outlined capsule |

Keep the hierarchy clear: **title → illustration → date → time → venue → entry**.

## 2. Story image — 9:16

**Canvas:** 1080 × 1920px  
**Safe area:** keep essential content between **y = 250px and y = 1600px**, with 90px side margins.

Duplicate the poster layout into the story canvas:
- Keep the title and all event details centered.
- Add cream space above and below rather than stretching the artwork.
- Extend the border vertically.
- Use small burgundy decorative lines in the extra space; add no new wording.

This creates a matching story without changing the design.

## 3. Reel — 9:16, 10 seconds

**Canvas:** 1080 × 1920px  
**Export:** MP4, 30fps; choose 480 × 854px for a smaller file, or 1080 × 1920px for a sharper export if your editor supports it.

Use the story design as the base. **Keep all event text visible and stationary for the entire reel.** Animate only the saxophone and rooftop artwork.

| Time | Motion |
|---|---|
| 0–2 seconds | Artwork fades from 80% to 100% opacity |
| 2–8 seconds | Artwork slowly enlarges from 100% to 104% |
| 8–10 seconds | Hold the finished composition |

Keep the border and typography still so the details remain readable. Audio is optional; silence avoids music-licensing costs.

### Date check before exporting

Use **one persistent date layer** reading **24 October 2027** throughout the reel. If your editor creates separate scenes or an outro, copy that same layer into each one. Check for **“17 October 2027”** in hidden layers, duplicated pages and end cards before exporting.

**Suggested filenames**
- `Rooftop-Jazz_24-Oct-2027_Poster_4x5.png`
- `Rooftop-Jazz_24-Oct-2027_Story_9x16.png`
- `Rooftop-Jazz_24-Oct-2027_Reel_10s.mp4`
